description: Synthetic EDGAR full-index fixture bundle for the FRAME builder. Every CIK, company name, accession, and date is invented for methodological testing; no real company data. The three files reproduce the exact master.idx structural format: variable historical preamble text, the canonical column-header line, the dashed separator, and pipe-delimited data rows. Cases cover plain 10-K and 10-KT filings, a 20-F and a 20-F/A extension filing, a matched 10-K/A, an orphan 10-K/A, out-of-scope forms (10-Q, 8-K, 10-Q/A), an identical duplicate row across two files at one (CIK, accession) key, conflicting rows at one same-filer (CIK, accession) key, a legitimate combined multi-filer 10-K (one accession under three filer CIKs, per ADR-080), a combined two-filer 40-F pair (used by the DERA validation fixtures' PARTIAL registrant-set case, ADR-081), a malformed line, an invalid CIK, rows outside the filing window on both sides, and one CIK with two annual filings to exercise filing-history preservation.
